why_lead: Tesla is out as the lead. Its 2025-03-10 smaller trade already made the boycott-is-a-bargain case, and the draft lead repeated that angle and its Yahoo gut-check evidence under a new subtitle; the 15.43% session is a price change, which does not justify another full essay. Robinhood is the best distinct narrative: a 19.79% prior-session drop and a 36.22% fall over 20 sessions sit beside a dated retail-attention item (MarketWatch, retail traders getting spooked), a regulatory item tied to the GameStop chaos (Finance Magnates) and a rival's product launch (Webull). Robinhood itself has never been a lead or a smaller trade; earlier mentions were supporting detail only.
why_smaller: Oklo: nuclear appeared once before as NuScale's 2025-03-04 smaller trade on the AI-power rotation, so this is a changed story. Alphabet's small-reactor plan and the administration's stated support are new catalysts, and OKLO's -57.31% over 20 sessions is the largest drawdown in the card.
Natural gas: non-equity and non-AI, and new to the archive. NG=F's +35.72% over 20 sessions is the largest move among the card's commodities, with a leveraged-ETF retail route (BOIL and KOLD).

Rocket Lab: new to the archive. It replaces the ASTS satellite smaller trade of 2025-03-05, whose Eutelsat evidence was already the 2025-03-10 lead's social signal. RKLB brings a product event (the Neutron sea-landing plan) and the 'set you up for life' pitch.
